script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Romance
Theme: career transition

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. COFFEE SHOP - MORNING

JANE (mid 30s, ambitious, yet disillusioned), sits alone at a table, poring over her laptop. She's in a deep thought as she sips her coffee.

WAITRESS (early 20s)
Another coffee for you, ma'am?

JANE
No, thank you. I think I'll stick with this one for a while.

The waitress nods and leaves. Jane looks up at the clock, seeing the time read 11:00 AM. She closes her laptop and gathers her things.

INT. JANE'S APARTMENT - LIVING ROOM - AFTERNOON

Jane enters her apartment, looking around at the cluttered space. She lets out a deep sigh.

JANE
(to herself)
I can't keep living like this.

She sits on the couch, staring at her resume on the coffee table. Her phone rings, and she picks it up.

JANE
(answering)
Hello?

TOM (early 40s, kind, supportive)
Hey, it's Tom. I was just thinking about you and your job situation. I know it's not easy, but have you considered a career change?

JANE
(hesitant)
I don't know. I've always thought of myself as a lawyer. It's all I've ever wanted.

TOM
But is it really making you happy? I remember how passionate you were about writing when we first met.

Jane thinks for a moment before speaking.

JANE
I do miss it. But it's been so long. I don't know if I have what it takes anymore.

TOM
(encouraging)
You've always had what it takes, Jane. And I believe in you. Why don't you give it a try? Start small, maybe write a short story or a blog post.

Jane nods, inspired.

JANE
Okay, Tom. I will.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - EVENING

Jane sits at the same table, now with a notebook and pen instead of a laptop. She looks up as a familiar face approaches.

ADAM (mid 30s, attractive, mysterious)
Hey, it's been a while. How have you been?

JANE
(surprised)
Adam! I'm good. And you?

ADAM
Same old, same old. But I see you've changed things up a bit.

JANE
(smiling)
Yes, I've decided to give writing another try.

ADAM
(impressed)
That's great, Jane. I always knew you had talent.

They share a meaningful look.

INT. JANE'S APARTMENT - LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Jane sits in front of her laptop, typing away at a new story. She looks up at the clock, seeing the time read midnight. She stretches, feeling a sense of accomplishment.

JANE
(to herself)
I've got this.

INT. JANE'S APARTMENT - LIVING ROOM - MORNING

Jane wakes up early, ready to continue her writing. She looks out the window, seeing the sun rising.

JANE
(whispering)
This is the start of a new chapter.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - MORNING

Jane sits at the same table, now surrounded by her notebooks and laptop. She looks up as Adam enters the coffee shop. He approaches her table, a smile on his face.

ADAM
Morning, Jane. I see you're still at it.

JANE
(smiling back)
Yes, I am. And I couldn't do it without your encouragement.

ADAM
(grinning)
I'm just glad to see you following your dreams.

They share a moment of silence, both knowing the importance of their conversation.

FADE OUT.

THE END.
